summary: New file adds a JSON array of 20 trigger-eval queries for the debug-loop skill. Each entry pairs a natural-language user request with a should_trigger boolean. Eleven positives cover build failures, red tests, pasted tracebacks, regressions, CI failures, a trivial typo, a restart after failed fixes, intermittent login bounces, a latency regression, and a nightly queue backup. Nine negatives cover feature work, PR review, refactoring, TDD, error-handling cleanup, code walkthroughs, lint noise, brainstorming, and theory questions. No harness or scoring logic appears in the chunk; the file is data only.
